claims.statement: The Persistence tool window shows persistence units, managed entities and Spring repositories for the project.
claims.supports: tool window shows configuration files, persistence units, managed entities, Spring repositories, converters
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the native Persistence tree view model (OpenIDEA has no JPA Structure tool window; the plugin's Persistence view is its equivalent): persistence units, managed entities and their Spring Data repositories are nodes nested unit > entity > Repositories > repository (RS-810). Not checked: tool window layout and drawing, and the original's configuration-file and converter rows.

claims.statement: The JPA Structure Repositories section groups all repositories of each entity regardless of package, with jump-to or create-new.
claims.supports: groups all repositories for each entity in one place regardless of package
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the Persistence view: each entity's Repositories group lists its repositories across packages (RS-811), the Repositories item menu creates a new repository (RS-812) and activating a repository node calls open-location (RS-813). Not checked: that an editor actually opens (the runner cannot observe it) and the original's tool window drawing.
